'''Palóc soup''' ([[Hungarian language|Hungarian]]: ''palócleves'') is a soup similar to Hungarian [[Gulyásleves|goulash]] soup, but lighter and a bit sour in taste.<ref name="origo">{{cite web|url=http://www.origo.hu/tafelspicc/recept/20150623-palocleves-amit-nem-is-a-palocak-talaltak-ki-recept-mikszath-gundel.html|title=Palócleves, amit nem is a palócok találtak ki|date=2015-06-24|accessdate=2015-06-25|publisher=Origo|language=Hungarian}}</ref> Contrary to popular opinion,<ref>{{cite book|chapter-url=https://books.google.com/books?id=G9lxnIrrQ9IC&q=pal%C3%B3c+soup&pg=PT71|title=The Best Soups in the World |author=Clifford A. Wright |author-link=Clifford A. Wright |chapter=palóc soup|publisher=Houghton Mifflin Harcourt|year=2011|isbn=9780544177796}}</ref> the soup was not named after the [[Palóc]] people.<ref name="origo" />
